question: Should OpenClaw add Grok 4.5 as a first-class bundled xAI model now while keeping Grok 4.3 as the setup default for regional safety?
rationale: The patch is narrow and evidence-backed, but bundled provider catalogs and default live lanes are maintainer-owned product/provider decisions and the PR carries the protected maintainer label.

options.title: Accept Grok 4.5 with Grok 4.3 default
options.body: Merge the additive catalog, alias, reasoning, docs, and live-lane update after exact-head checks pass, preserving Grok 4.3 as the setup default.

options.title: Hold for broader availability
options.body: Pause until xAI regional availability is stable enough that publishing Grok 4.5 will not confuse unsupported API-key users.

options.title: Narrow to catalog only
options.body: Add only selectable/static metadata now and leave the high-signal live lane on Grok 4.3 until live-test environments are proven stable.

recommendation.title: Accept Grok 4.5 with Grok 4.3 default
recommendation.body: Merge the additive catalog, alias, reasoning, docs, and live-lane update after exact-head checks pass, preserving Grok 4.3 as the setup default.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current PR, are assigned to the linked issue, and have prior xAI catalog/default history.
